header: The SAIL P.No. is a password: it is the first password of every account (src/lib/employees/admin/store.ts hashes it), so I never let it leave the server in a directory answer. A card shows it masked: the first and the last character only ("D000896" -> "D•••••6"), enough to tell two people apart, not enough to sign in (the hidden part is five characters, and the login locks after a few wrong tries: src/lib/auth.ts). Pure.

symbols.name: maskPno
symbols.sig: export function maskPno(p: string | null | undefined): string | null
doc: I hide a value of 3 characters or fewer entirely: "D000896" -> "D•••••6"; nothing -> null

behaviours: a P.No. is shown as its first and last character only
a short value is hidden entirely; nothing stays nothing
the masked value never contains the middle of the original
${f} masks the P.No. in the card it builds, and builds no card with the raw column (the roster path hands its row to the same masking builder)
a lookup by P.No. (and by mobile or CUG) in the open search route needs a signed-in person (401 otherwise), and the check comes before the database is asked
the open search route is rate-limited (429 with Retry-After) by address, or by ticket when signed in
the HOD's real P.No. is nowhere in the code, the user manual or the tests (a sample P.No. is used instead)
